title: Senior Data Engineering Analyst
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Data Engineering & Pipeline Development
  + Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes supporting batch and streaming workloads
  + Build and optimize data ingestion frameworks using technologies such as Apache Spark, Kafka, and cloud-native services
  + Integrate data from multiple internal and external source systems while ensuring data quality, consistency, and governance
  + Develop and maintain data orchestration workflows to ensure reliable delivery of business-critical datasets
* Data Architecture & Modeling
  + Design and optimize data warehouses, data lakes, and lakehouse architectures
  + Build scalable and efficient data models supporting enterprise reporting, analytics, and AI/ML use cases
  + Work with platforms such as Snowflake, Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, and cloud-based data ecosystems
  + Define and maintain data contracts, metadata standards, and lineage frameworks
* Data Security, Governance & Compliance
  + Design secure and compliant data pipelines incorporating encryption, IAM, RBAC, audit logging, and access controls
  + Implement data classification, masking, tokenization, and lineage solutions for sensitive healthcare data including PII and PHI
  + Support adherence to HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC 2, and enterprise security requirements
  + Contribute to audit readiness by maintaining controls documentation, access reviews, lineage records, and compliance evidence
* Data Reliability & Observability
  + Own data quality, observability, monitoring, and reliability for assigned business domains
  + Establish and monitor SLAs, data validation checks, and alerting mechanisms
  + Troubleshoot production issues, optimize performance, and ensure platform stability
  + Drive best practices around data testing, monitoring, and operational excellence
* Cloud & Platform Engineering
  + Support and enhance modern cloud-based data platforms, with a strong preference for AWS technologies
  + Implement CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and automated deployment practices
  + Optimize infrastructure utilization through right-sizing, auto-scaling, partitioning, clustering, and cost-management strategies
  + Contribute to platform automation and engineering process improvements
* Analytics & AI Enablement
  + Collaborate with Analytics, BI, and Data Science teams to enable reporting, advanced analytics, machine learning, and AI solutions
  + Develop feature stores and ML-ready datasets for predictive modeling initiatives
  + Ensure data accessibility, consistency, and reliability for downstream analytical applications
* Documentation & Leadership
  + Create and maintain technical documentation, architecture diagrams, schemas, and operational procedures
  + Document end-to-end data lineage, governance frameworks, and engineering standards
  + Mentor Associate and Junior Data Engineers, promoting engineering best practices and knowledge sharing
  + Stay current with emerging technologies, cloud innovations, security standards, and modern data engineering methodologies
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Engineering, Engineering, or a related field
* 4+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Platform Engineering, or related areas
* Solid experience building and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines and large-scale data processing systems
* Hands-on experience with Apache Spark and distributed data processing frameworks
* Experience working with Kafka or other streaming technologies
* Experience with Snowflake, Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, or similar cloud data platforms
* Solid knowledge of data warehousing and lakehouse architectures
* Solid understanding of data governance, metadata management, and data lineage concepts
* Familiarity with CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, and DevOps practices
* Proficiency in SQL and Python
* Proven excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills
* Proven solid communication and stakeholder management capabilities

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Hands-on experience with AWS services such as S3, Glue, EMR, Lambda, Redshift, IAM, KMS, and CloudWatch
* Experience implementing HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC2, or other regulated industry compliance requirements
* Experience supporting AI, Machine Learning, and Data Science workloads
* Experience with Terraform, Kubernetes, Docker, and modern cloud-native architectures
* Knowledge of data security practices including encryption, tokenization, data masking, and access management
* Familiarity with feature stores, MLOps, and ML data pipelines
* Proven exposure to vulnerability management tools such as Snyk, Wiz, Trivy, or equivalent

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

title: Senior Service Engineer - IT Infra and Cyber Security
description:
In our global IT software delivery centers, we are looking System Admins and Cyber Security Engineers.
  
The System Admin and Cybersecurity Engineer will work with teams comprised of Software
  
Engineers, Quality Engineers, User Interaction Design Engineers, Infrastructure/Platform team, and
  
the Product Owners to help lead the technical insight and industry perspective in the creation,
  
delivery, and integration of complex and comprehensive security solutions. You will be a security
  
evangelist helping engineers in secure implementation of technology stack in a cloud environment.
  
This position will be working on multiple projects as a technical expert or internal consultant. You will work on projects for components of the domain. You will work on multiple technical or functional domains.

===================

**In this role you will:**

* Participate in the domain technical and business discussions relative to future architect direction.

Technical Expertise:

* Ability and willingness to travel
* Fluent English speaker;
* Degree in Computer Science or equivalent knowledge or experience
* Proven track record of problem analysis, identification and resolution
* Excellent communication skills, commitment, discipline, positive attitude, following management prioritization, accountability and flexibility
* Strong understanding of ITIL and change management policies and procedures
* Strong IT experience in a technical hands-on position

* Network hardware: Cisco enterprise hardware. VLAN, ACL, routing and VPN - install, configure, manage
* Security management: Enterprise firewall equipment e.g. Cisco’s ASA / Fortinet’s Fortigate or equivalent – install, configure, manage

* Good knowledge about anti-virus implementations (McAfee EPO, Bitdefender, Microsoft Forefront, etc.)
* Good knowledge working with IPAMs and password solutions
* Experience in implementing and/or working with monitoring tools, log monitoring tools, log correlation tools.(Nagios, Graylog, Splunk, etc.)
* Very good Cyber/Security foundation

title: Senior Cloud Service Engineer
description:
**Job title: Senior Cloud Service Engineer**

**About the Role**

We are looking for a motivated **Cloud Service Engineer** to join the Digital Workplace Services team and support the security, administration and governance of our cloud and SaaS environment. The role will work across platforms including **Microsoft 365, Microsoft Entra ID, Google Workspace, Box** and other enterprise SaaS applications, supporting operational security, access governance, monitoring, troubleshooting and continuous improvement.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who wants to build hands-on experience across **cloud security, identity, SaaS security, data protection and AI security** within a large enterprise environment, working closely with senior engineers, security teams, platform owners, application teams and vendors.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **SaaS & Cloud Security:** Support administration, security governance, onboarding, configuration, lifecycle management and periodic reviews for Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Box, Lucidchart, Smartsheet and other enterprise SaaS platforms.
* **Identity & Access Management:** Support Microsoft Entra ID and Google Cloud Identity administration, including users, groups, applications, Conditional Access, MFA, authentication methods, guest access and privileged role governance.
* **Data Protection & Security Operations:** Assist with Microsoft Purview, Defender, DLP alert monitoring, external sharing reviews, security triage, remediation tracking and operational reporting.
* **AI & Emerging Technology Security:** Support governance and monitoring for enterprise AI services, Copilot, Copilot Studio, GenAI applications, agents, connectors and related data protection controls.
* **Security Monitoring & Investigation:** Monitor dashboards and alerts across SaaS and cloud platforms, perform initial investigation, use tools such as Defender, Purview, Sentinel and SaaS security platforms, and escalate complex issues where required.
* **Platform Operations & Troubleshooting:** Provide second-line support for authentication, provisioning, synchronization, SSO, SAML, SCIM, OAuth, API integrations, vendor issues, change implementation and validation.
* **Governance, Documentation & Improvement:** Maintain inventories, ownership records, runbooks, knowledge articles, configuration records and operational procedures while identifying automation and process improvement opportunities.

**Key Technologies**

The role will have exposure to the following technology areas:

* **Identity & Cloud:** Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft 365, Azure, Google Cloud Identity and Google Workspace.
* **Security:** Microsoft Purview, Microsoft Defender, Microsoft Sentinel, Defender for Cloud Apps, Conditional Access, DLP and SaaS security/application governance.
* **SaaS Platforms:** Box, Lucidchart, Smartsheet, Adobe Apps and other enterprise SaaS applications.
* **AI Security:** Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Azure AI / AI Foundry, AI governance and data protection controls.
* **Automation & Technical Tools:** PowerShell, KQL, Power Automate, REST APIs, Microsoft Graph, SAML, SCIM and OAuth.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 5+ years of experience in cloud administration, SaaS administration, IT security, identity management or a related technical role.
* Basic understanding of Microsoft 365 and/or Azure, identity and access management, SSO, MFA and authentication concepts.
* Understanding of security fundamentals, including access control, least privilege, data protection and operational security monitoring.
* Good troubleshooting and analytical skills, including the ability to investigate issues using logs, dashboards and administrative portals.
* Basic PowerShell or scripting knowledge, with willingness to learn KQL and security monitoring tools.
* Good written and verbal communication skills, ability to work with technical teams and vendors, and strong attention to detail in documentation.

**Desirable Skills**

* Experience with Microsoft Entra ID, Purview, Defender, Sentinel/KQL, Google Workspace Administration, Google Cloud Identity, Box administration/Box Shield, SaaS security or CASB.
* Experience with OAuth application governance, SAML, SCIM, Microsoft Graph, PowerShell, Power Automate, cloud security, DLP, AI security or AI governance.

Relevant Microsoft, Google, security or cloud certifications would be advantageous but are not mandatory.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Independently handle routine SaaS and cloud security operations.
* Identify and resolve common identity, access, platform configuration and security alert issues.
* Maintain accurate application, access, security governance and remediation records.
* Improve documentation, repeatable processes, automation and operational efficiency.
* Develop deeper expertise across Microsoft, Google, SaaS, cloud, data protection and AI security platforms.

**Working Relationships**

The role will work closely with Digital Workplace Services, Cyber Security/SOC, Identity & Access Management, Microsoft 365/Azure engineering teams, Google Cloud/Google Workspace teams, Data Protection/Privacy, Application and Enterprise Architecture teams, SaaS application owners and external technology vendors.

**Ideal Candidate**

We are looking for someone who is **curious, technically hands-on, security-minded and willing to learn** . The ideal candidate has a strong foundation in IT, cloud or security and wants to develop into a broader SaaS, Cloud and AI Security Engineer.

* Enjoys troubleshooting complex technical problems and learning new platforms quickly.
* Takes ownership of issues while knowing when to seek guidance.
* Communicates clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Has strong attention to detail and follows through on operational tasks.
* Is interested in emerging technologies, particularly cloud and AI security.

**Who we are:**

At Pearson, our purpose is simple: to help people realize the life they imagine through learning. We believe that every learning opportunity is a chance for a personal breakthrough. We are the world's lifelong learning company. For us, learning isn't just what we do. It's who we are. To learn more: We are Pearson.

Pearson is an Equal Opportunity Employer and a member of E-Verify. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status or any other group protected by law. We actively seek qualified candidates who are protected veterans and individuals with disabilities as defined under VEVRAA and Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act.

If you are an individual with a disability and are unable or limited in your ability to use or access our career site as a result of your disability, you may request reasonable accommodations by emailing TalentExperienceGlobalTeam@grp.pearson.com.

title: Senior Computer Scientist - C++
description:
The Opportunity
  
Adobe builds products that power millions of customer experiences worldwide. Behind these products are sophisticated software systems operating at scale, where performance, reliability, security, and engineering excellence are fundamental requirements.
  
We are looking for a Senior Computer Scientist with deep C\+\+ expertise who enjoys solving complex technical problems and taking ownership of significant areas of the product. You will shape architecture, build high\-performance software, make critical technical decisions, and influence solutions that span components and teams.
  
We value engineers who are self\-driven, proactive, and outcome\-oriented — engineers who challenge assumptions, solve problems at their root, make pragmatic tradeoffs, and take responsibility for making the systems they own better, more reliable, and easier to evolve.
  
  

What You'll Do
  
Own and evolve significant technical areas end\-to\-end — from understanding ambiguous problems and defining the right solution through architecture, implementation, production validation, and long\-term evolution.
  
Design and build high\-performance C\+\+ systems , making thoughtful decisions around architecture, concurrency, memory management, resource utilization, and scalability.
  
Drive technical direction for complex problems — evaluate alternatives, make pragmatic tradeoffs, and influence architecture decisions across components and teams.
  
Solve problems at the root — identify systemic causes rather than treating symptoms, and drive durable solutions that reduce recurring issues and technical debt.
  
Own outcomes, not just tasks — proactively identify gaps, risks, and opportunities and drive them to closure with minimal direction.
  
Solve complex problems across boundaries , collaborating with engineers, architects, product managers, and other teams to deliver cohesive solutions.
  
Raise the engineering bar through architecture and code reviews, performance optimization, testing, and engineering best practices.
  
Build for operational excellence with strong focus on performance, reliability, security, observability, maintainability, and efficient resource utilization.
  
Be a force multiplier — mentor engineers, share technical expertise, and establish patterns and practices that improve the broader engineering organization.

What You Need to Succeed

10\+ years of hands\-on software engineering experience , with a strong track record of owning and delivering complex technical solutions.
  
Deep expertise in C\+\+ , including modern C\+\+, memory management, concurrency, multithreading, STL, and performance optimization.

Experience building or operating Distributed systems at scale , with an understanding of multi\-tenancy, scaling, reliability, backward compatibility, security, observability, and capacity planning.

Experience with cloud platforms, distributed infrastructure, and modern software development practices.
  
Strong proficiency in AI\-assisted engineering , leveraging tools such as Claude, Codex, or Copilot to accelerate development, improve problem solving, and enhance engineering productivity.
  
Strong technical judgment and problem\-solving ability , with the ability to navigate ambiguity and influence technical decisions across teams.
  
  

What Success Looks Like
  
Success in this role is not measured only by the features you deliver. You will be successful when you:
  
Own and evolve significant technical areas with minimal direction and strong technical judgment.
  
Turn ambiguous, complex problems into clear technical direction and executable solutions .
  
Make architecture decisions that balance performance, scalability, reliability, maintainability, and long\-term evolution .
  
Solve systemic problems at their root and eliminate recurring sources of complexity, performance issues, and operational risk.
  
Influence technical direction across teams and organizational boundaries through technical depth and credibility.

title: R&D Engineering, Sr Engineer
description:
### **We Are**
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

### **You Are**


You are someone who looks at a test failure and does not just log it, you dig until you understand why it happened and what it means for the next release. Scripting is not a chore for you, it is how you make repetitive work disappear so you can focus on the problems that actually need a human brain. You have spent enough time in labs or codebases to know that quality is not something you test in at the end, it is something you build into the process from the start.


Data tells you stories. When you see a trend in regression results, you do not wait for someone else to notice, you pull the thread, ask the right questions, and surface what matters. You are comfortable working across teams, translating between what verification found, what design needs to know, and what a release checklist actually requires.


You do not need years of experience to have a point of view. You know when a process is not working and you are not afraid to suggest a better way. At Synopsys, you will work on Embedded Memory IP that powers the devices people use every day, and the rigor you bring to testing and automation will directly affect whether those products ship on time and work as promised.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* Run kickoff and release meetings across design, verification, and release teams, making sure compliance checkpoints are hit and nothing falls through the cracks
* Execute regression testing on Embedded Memory IP, catch issues before they reach customers, and track results across release cycles
* Analyze test data to spot trends, recurring failures, and process gaps that affect product quality or schedule
* Write and maintain Python and Tcl automation scripts that eliminate manual testing steps and speed up validation workflows
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams to align on quality gates, release criteria, and issue resolution timelines
* Document test results, failure analysis, and process improvements in a way that helps the next engineer understand what happened and why

### **The Impact You Will Have**

* Ensure Embedded Memory IP on advanced process nodes ships with zero critical defects, directly affecting customer success and market readiness
* Reduce validation cycle time by automating repetitive test and data collection tasks, freeing engineers to focus on complex debug work
* Surface quality and process issues early in the development cycle, preventing costly delays and rework downstream
* Improve the reliability of regression infrastructure so teams can trust test results and make faster release decisions
* Strengthen compliance and traceability across the release process, reducing risk and audit friction
* Enable smarter decision\-making by turning raw test data into actionable insights for design and verification teams

### **What You'll Need**

* Bachelor's degree in Electronics and Communication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field
* 2 years of experience in validation, testing, quality assurance, or a related engineering role
* Working knowledge of Python or Tcl for scripting and automation
* Ability to analyze data, identify patterns, and communicate findings clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences
* Familiarity with regression testing, release processes, or quality management systems is a plus
* Strong problem\-solving instincts and the ability to work across teams without losing track of details

### **Who You Are**

* You can look at a spreadsheet of test results and spot the one anomaly that matters, not just the loudest failure
* You write scripts that other people can actually read and modify six months later
* You are comfortable running a meeting with senior engineers and keeping it focused without being intimidated
* When a process does not make sense, you ask why before you follow it blindly
* You can explain a technical issue to a release manager in two sentences without losing the nuance
* You stay organized when managing multiple release tracks, test cycles, and compliance checkpoints at once

### **The Team You'll Be Part Of**


Your recruiter will share more about the team structure and mission during the interview process.

### **Rewards and Benefits**


We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.
